effect.purpose: Read-only Effect v4 source pinned to the tag matching the version of `effect` this repo installs — the authority on what v4 actually exports, plus the v3→v4 migration notes and the @effected/vitest reference implementation. Re-pin whenever the effect catalog moves, in the same commit as the bump. This purpose deliberately does NOT name the version: an inline version literal is a second source of truth that goes stale silently while `ref` is updated, which is exactly what happened at the beta.107 pin. Verify by comparing packages/effect/package.json at the pinned commit against node_modules, never by reading the tag name.

orientation.layout: Sparse checkout: packages/effect (core source + package.json exports map), packages/vitest (@effect/vitest reference implementation), migration/ (per-domain v3→v4 notes), ai-docs/, LLMS.md, MIGRATION.md.
orientation.startHere: packages/effect/src settles what v4 actually exports; migration/*.md settles v3→v4 renames. Before trusting an answer, confirm the pin matches the installed effect version (`node -p "require('./node_modules/effect/package.json').version"` against `.repos/effect/packages/effect/package.json`) — node_modules wins on disagreement.
